thread:
cs-lead: Hey team, multiple CS tickets saying hosted API returned 503s starting ~10:42 UTC. Customers report timeouts and retries. Can we triage?

sre-bot: [ALERT] upstream-runner-exit x4 in hosted-east-1 (10:41:52 -> 10:43:15)
sre-bot: alert_id=7891234567 runbook=https://internal.redwood/runbooks/upstream-crash

eng-oncall: I'm taking this. Pulling logs from pool hosted-east-1-gpu now. Anyone saw correlated deploys or config changes?

jordan: ACME flagged repeated 503s, sample_req=req_acme_20260318_1. Billing already noticed extra retries and token charge spike.

alex: Pasted a snippet from worker-481 logs:
```
[10:42:07] runtime: gpu memory exceeded limit
[10:42:07] infer_runner: CUDA OOM at attention_kernel.cu:274
[10:42:07] infer_runner: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8a3b12
[10:42:07] container: restarting (code=137)
```
Core dump archived: gs://redwood-debug/7891234567/worker-481-core.tar.gz

meera: That pool hot-swapped redwood-13b-qt4 (quant int4) at ~10:40 during autoscaler changes. We've seen small allocator regressions after the last change.

alex: Metrics around crash:
- kv_cache_usage=11.8GB
- model_params_resident=22.6GB
- gpu_total_used=34.4GB
GPU per-node limit=32GB -> OOM before segfault.

eng-oncall: Who pushed the autoscale tweak and what did it change?

meera: I changed the autoscaler concurrency target 0.6 -> 0.8 at 10:39 to absorb a spike. That increased parallel in-flight requests and larger contiguous allocations. Reverting now.

eng-oncall: Revert in progress. Also pinning model variant back to redwood-13b-qt2 for that pool as emergency mitigation.

cs-lead: Jordan, summarize customer impact and billing exposure for ACME.

jordan: ACME impacted 10:42 -> 10:58; retries show 503 then retries. Billing sees ~1200 extra token attempts. CS scheduled a credit call. They've requested timeline and repro steps.

alex: Local repro notes so far:
1) Simulate batchsize spike (k=16->512) under redwood-13b-qt4
2) Enable KV prefetch and sustained concurrent streaming
3) Hot-swap quantized model variant during load
4) Observe GPU memory climb -> CUDA OOM -> SIGSEGV
Command used:
```
LOAD_TEST_OPTS="--concurrency 120 --batch-shape 512" ./tools/loadtest --model redwood-13b-qt4 --enable-prefetch
```

meera: Short-term mitigations applied/suggested:
- Revert autoscaler tweak (done)
- Pin model variant in hosted pool back to older quant (done)
- Disable kv-prefetch on heavy-embed/streaming routes for hosted-east-1 (applied)
- Add 20% allocator headroom guard to avoid contiguous overcommit

alex: Forensics: core/backtrace point to attention kernel allocation path. Suspect allocator alignment bug under high concurrency from autoscale change. Backtrace: gs://redwood-debug/7891234567/worker-481-backtrace.txt

eng-oncall: No other pools show the hot-swap. Impact limited to hosted-east-1. Pool concurrency reduced for 2h. Monitoring p95 latency.

meera: Engineering next steps:
- Reproduce with sanitizers in CI covering allocator change
- Add runtime pre-check to validate quant swap memory footprint before permitting hot-swap
- Cap max batchsize during hotmodel swap as safety
- Track ML-alloc-1723 to completion (assigned meera + alex)

cs-lead: Jordan please get ACME sample payloads for repro and coordinate billing ops for credit calculation. Draft a short external customer timeline.

jordan: Sent sample payload request to ACME and provided interim mitigation summary. Billing ops queued credit calc.

alex: Emergency allocator patch in staging (commit ab12f3) adds 256MB safety margin. Canary to prod planned in 30m if staging green.

meera: Filing follow-up ML-alloc-1723. Note: do NOT re-enable kv-prefetch on that pool until allocator patch is rolled.

eng-oncall: 503 rate returned to baseline by 10:58 after mitigations. Still monitoring.

sre-bot: INCIDENT 7891234567: mitigated via autoscaler revert & model pin. Runbook follow-up required.

cs-lead: Thanks. Save all logs and artifacts to incident folder, tag with evidence IDs, and prepare customer-facing RCA draft.

alex: :thumbsup:

jordan: ACME provided sample payloads to eng-oncall and requested a follow-up call about credits.

eng-oncall: Closing thread after RCA posted. Update #incidents for watchers.
